title: MPX EncounterPlus V5 Module
description: Configuration for an EncounterPlus V5 module project created with Module Packer Extended.

id.markdownDescription: *Required.* Persistent UUID of the module. Keep this value unchanged between releases of the same module.
id.patternErrorMessage: The module id must be a valid UUID.

slug.markdownDescription: *Required.* Stable text identifier without accents or spaces. Separate words with hyphens.
slug.patternErrorMessage: The slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (no spaces, accents, or uppercase).

acronym.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Short name or acronym used to identify the module.

category.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Category used by EncounterPlus to classify the module. Leave empty until a category is chosen.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"adventure"`, `"pack"`, `"rules"`, `"compendium"`, `"other"`.

author.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Name of the module author or publisher.

examples: A short summary of the module.
A detailed description of the module and its contents.

tags.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Array of keywords used to describe and find the module.

Example: `["adventure", "dnd5e"]`

Empty: `[]`

image.markdownDescription: *Optional.* File name of the module cover image, relative to the project root.

banner.markdownDescription: *Optional.* File name of the module banner image, relative to the project root.

website.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Website URL for the module or its author.

repository.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Source repository URL for the module.

package.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Package or download URL for the module.
